verses.gurmukhi: ਵੇਦ ਕਤੇਬਹੁ ਬਾਹਰਾ ਲੇਖ ਅਲੇਖ ਨ ਲਖਿਆ ਜਾਈ।
verses.translit_en: vedh katebahu baaharaa lekh alekh na lakhiaa jaiee|

en.bdb: God is beyond Vedas and katebas (holy books of Semitic religions) and He cannot be visualized.

verses.gurmukhi: ਰੂਪ ਅਨੂਪੁ ਅਚਰਜੁ ਹੈ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਅਗੋਚਰ ਭਾਈ।
verses.translit_en: roop anoop acharaj hai dharasan dhirasaT agochar bhaiee|

en.bdb: His form is grand and awe-inspiring. He is beyond the reach of body organs.

verses.gurmukhi: ਇਕੁ ਕਵਾਉ ਪਸਾਉ ਕਰਿ ਤੋਲੁ ਨ ਤੁਲਾਧਾਰ ਨ ਸਮਾਈ।
verses.translit_en: eik kavaau pasaau kar tol na tulaadhaar na samaiee|

en.bdb: He created this cosmos by His one big bang which cannot be weighed on any scale.

verses.gurmukhi: ਕਥਨੀ ਬਦਨੀ ਬਾਹਰਾ ਥਕੈ ਸਬਦੁ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ।
verses.translit_en: kathanee badhanee baaharaa thakai sabadh surat liv laiee|

en.bdb: He is indescribable and many men in order to reach Him have gotten tired by putting their consciousness into the Word.

verses.gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਬਚ ਕਰਮ ਅਗੋਚਰਾ ਮਤਿ ਬੁਧਿ ਸਾਧਿ ਸੋਝੀ ਥਕਿ ਪਾਈ।
verses.translit_en: man bach karam agocharaa mat budh saadh sojhee thak paiee|

en.bdb: Being beyond the ken of mind, speech, and action, the wisdom, intellect and all practices have also left hope of catching hold of Him.

verses.gurmukhi: ਅਛਲ ਅਛੇਦ ਅਭੇਦ ਹੈ ਭਗਤਿ ਵਛਲੁ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਛਾਈ।
verses.translit_en: achhal achhedh abhedh hai bhagat vachhal saadhasa(n)gat chhaiee|

en.bdb: Undeceivable, beyond time and non dual, the Lord is kind to devotees and pervades through the holy congregation.
He is great and His grandeur is also great
